runtime: Java SE platform (java.base); also used for JDK callees reached from Scala
conventions: Symbols are fully qualified class + member (java.lang.Thread.start); constructors use the class name. A method reference or lambda argument always targets a functional interface (language rule, no row).

entries.describe: thread.start() runs the thread's run() (a Thread subclass override) on a new thread
entries.why: start() hands the thread to the native start0; the JVM calls run() from native code

entries.describe: addShutdownHook(thread) runs thread.run() when the JVM shuts down
entries.why: the hook is started by the JVM's shutdown sequence from native code

entries.describe: timer.schedule(task, ...) runs task.run() later on the timer thread
entries.why: TimerTask is an abstract class, not a functional interface: the parameter type does not say that run() is called

entries.describe: threadLocal.get() calls the subclass override initialValue() on first use
entries.why: a template-method call on the receiver's override, not on a parameter

entries.describe: string conversion of an Object argument calls its toString()
entries.why: the parameter is typed Object; toString() is dispatched on the argument's class

entries.describe: hash containers call hashCode() and equals() of the key
entries.why: the key is typed Object/K; the calls are dispatched on the key's class

entries.describe: sorted containers without a Comparator call the key's compareTo()
entries.why: the key is typed K; Comparable.compareTo is dispatched on the key's class

entries.describe: serialization calls the class's private writeObject(ObjectOutputStream) and writeReplace()
entries.why: the methods are found by name through reflection

io_send.describe: HttpClient.send(request, handler) sends the request to request.uri() with request.method() (JDK class without source when src.zip is absent)
HttpClient.sendAsync(request, handler) sends the request asynchronously
url.openConnection() opens a connection to the URL (HttpURLConnection.setRequestMethod sets the verb)
new Socket(host, port) opens a raw socket
new ProcessBuilder(command...) + start() runs a program

io_entry.describe: Servlet specification: the container calls service(request, response), which dispatches to doGet/doPost/... of the servlet subclass
Servlet specification (javax): the container calls service(request, response)

reflection_roots.describe: Spring scans handler methods annotated (directly or through meta-annotations such as @GetMapping, derived via @AliasFor) with @RequestMapping
JAX-RS scans resource classes and methods annotated with @Path
JAX-RS verb annotations (@GET, @POST, ...) are meta-annotated with @HttpMethod("GET")
JAX-RS (javax) scans resource classes and methods annotated with @Path
JAX-RS (javax) verb annotations are meta-annotated with @HttpMethod
the container registers servlets annotated with @WebServlet(urlPatterns)
the container registers servlets annotated with @WebServlet(urlPatterns) (javax)

route_patterns.describe: brace placeholder with a regular expression

ffi_conventions.describe: JNI: a native method m of class p.C is implemented by the C symbol Java_p_C_m (mangled) or registered with RegisterNatives
loads the native library that implements native methods (runs its JNI_OnLoad)
loads a native library by path

test_conventions.describe: JUnit 5 runs methods annotated with @Test (and @ParameterizedTest, @RepeatedTest meta-annotated with @Testable)
JUnit 4 runs public methods annotated with @Test

syntax_conventions.describe: protoc-gen-grpc-java generates the class <Service>Grpc holding the stubs and the server base of the service
a subclass of the generated <Service>Grpc.<Service>ImplBase implements the service's rpcs
Spring for GraphQL scans @QueryMapping methods and binds them to the Query field of the same name
Spring for GraphQL scans @MutationMapping methods and binds them to the Mutation field of the same name
Spring for GraphQL scans @SubscriptionMapping methods and binds them to the Subscription field of the same name
@SchemaMapping(typeName = "T") binds the method to the field of type T
the name element of a field annotation names the field (default: the method name)
the value element of a field annotation names the field (default: the method name)
the field element of @SchemaMapping names the field (default: the method name)
